_help_1: EDIT THE NUMBERS to match a real cabinet from your shop, save, then run:
_help_2: lua55 main.lua templates/MY-CABINET.json out en  (or lua54 - whichever you have)
_help_3: Every _help line is ignored by the system - it is only for you.
_help_units: mm or in - all numbers below are in this unit
_help_panel: the board you build boxes from
_help_sheet: your board size - used for the material estimate
_help_fronts: overlay gaps: reveal = gap between doors/drawer fronts, edge = gap to cabinet edge

cabinets._help_id: any name - appears on every part label

construction._help_back: grooved = back panel in a groove; nailed = back nailed on the rear

cabinets._help_zones: split the cabinet height into zones, from bottom (0) to top (height)

zones._help_z1: drawers at the bottom - count = how many; box:true also cuts the drawer box

zones._help_z2: doors above - count 1-4; shelves = adjustable shelves BEHIND the doors

cabinets._help_hw: hardware from the library - or write null to disable one
